notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
easyPrerequisites:
Emmara has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate a creature using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping Emmara.
Activate Emmara using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 2, untapping another creature.
Repeat.
